maria (marketing): Quick sync — final announce checklist for Release 6.2. Need confirmation on:
- changelog link (final PR)
- docs link (how-to + migration snippet)
- canary / rollout timing for hosted API
- benchmark blurb + perf artifacts for blog + webinar
- inbound lead webhook details and sample payload
Planning to send the embargoed announcement Tue 10:30am PST. Can eng/docs/sales confirm?
ryan (eng): changelog PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/528 (will merge at canary start).
Docs PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1123 (docs reviewed; staging ready).
Canary window: Tue 09:45–10:45 PST at 10% traffic. If green, bump to 50% at 11:15 PST and full by 12:00 PST. Embargo holds until 10:30 PST. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-03-24T09:45:00-08:00 (initiated by ryan). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/6792
jay (docs): Docs PR merged to staging — staging URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/release-6.2
I will promote to prod after canary passes. Adding a short migration snippet at the top and a ‘what changed’ diff block. I'll also include an FAQ item for common upgrade errors.
olivia (sales): For inbound leads, sales wants webhook to populate SF demo queue and include fields: email, company, trial=true/false, company_size, region, utm.
Can eng expose an endpoint we can test before prod? Also need HMAC auth on the webhook.
ryan (eng): Endpoint for staging: https://hooks.staging.redwood.ai/mktg/leads
Auth: HMAC header x-rw-hmac: sha256(<secret>, payload) — we'll give a test secret in Secrets Manager.
Example payload we expect (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.staging.redwood.ai/mktg/leads \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-rw-hmac: sha256=..." \
  -d '{"email":"jane@example.com","company":"Acme","trial":true,"company_size":"50-200","region":"NA","utm_source":"webinar"}'
```
I'll add this example to the docs PR.
matt (pm): Webinar rehearsal Wed 11:00am PT. Bench narrative for slides: show before/after (baseline vs batching+quantization). We should avoid absolute guarantees in headline — Maria, marketing wants a short headline. Can we conservatively say "up to 2x throughput, typical 20–35% cost savings depending on workload"?
maria (marketing): Yes — use conservative phrasing. Headline: "Up to 2x throughput and typical 20–35% cost savings depending on workload." We'll call out the specific test workload in appendix/notes. Also need perf CSV and screenshot for the blog hero.
ryan (eng): Perf artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/perf/release-6.2/reports.zip
Per-route latency CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/perf/release-6.2/per-route.csv
Note: numbers are median P50 / P95 per route. Include in appendix and mention test harness (open-sourced) — link in docs.
olivia (sales): Confirmed: once webhook is testable we'll run an end-to-end demo and validate fields. Please add a sample mapping to the SF queue (field names) in the docs so ops can wire it.
jay (docs): Will pin docs link in the changelog and add a short migration snippet with the example curl payload and webhook field mapping. Also will export the perf table as PNG for the blog hero.
maria (marketing): Great — marketing will queue the embargoed post and send invites for the webinar. Please ping here when canary completes and when docs are promoted to prod. Thanks team! :partyparrot:
